note: Received breakdown report. Contacting Anand Vihar depot manager.
Mechanic Raju dispatched from D2 depot. ETA 20 minutes.
Control room notified. Anand Vihar depot manager being contacted. Police PCR called.
Complaint logged. Forwarded to Ghaziabad depot manager for investigation.
Driver U19 called in. He states stop was skipped due to passengers blocking exit. Recording reviewed.
Driver counselled. Written warning issued. Complaint closed with resolution note sent to passenger.
Vehicle V20 brake warning acknowledged. Depot manager alerted to pull vehicle from service.
Vehicle returned to depot. Workshop team assigned for brake inspection.
Brake pads replaced. Vehicle cleared for service. Added to maintenance log.
Incident closed after 24-hour observation period. No recurrence.
GPS issue on V16 acknowledged. Tech team notified.
Remote restart of GPS device attempted. Partial fix — device now reporting but with 5-minute lag. On-site inspection scheduled for morning.
Minor accident logged. Ghaziabad depot manager notified. Driver asked to take photographs.
Damage assessed as cosmetic. Insurance team informed. Repair estimate requested from workshop.
Repair estimate received (Rs. 3,200). Insurance claim filed. Vehicle returned to service.
Passenger complaint regarding mobile phone usage escalated to D1 depot manager.
Driver U10 questioned. Denies using phone while driving. CCTV footage review initiated.
CCTV review inconclusive. Verbal warning issued to driver. Complaint closed.
Admin closed complaint after review. No further action.
Ticket machine issue acknowledged. Anand Vihar depot manager notified to arrange manual ticketing as interim measure.
